note: Describes how the settings app shows the values in settings.json. 'path' points into settings.json (defaults live there). 'advanced' entries are hidden until 'Show advanced' is switched on. Every entry is searchable from the launcher's Settings mode. 'group' sorts categories in the sidebar; 'section' is the sub-heading of an entry inside its category.

categories.title: Appearance
categories.description: Colours, light or dark, blur, motion and the wallpaper.

categories.title: Top bar
categories.description: What the top edge shows: the bar or the island, the clock and the bar contents.

categories.title: Island
categories.description: The floating island: its design, what it shows and when it opens.

categories.title: Dock
categories.description: The dock with your apps at the bottom edge.

categories.title: Control Center
categories.description: Which tiles the Control Center shows.

categories.title: Notifications
categories.description: Where and how long popups appear.

categories.title: Launcher
categories.description: Searching and starting things, and the web search.

categories.title: AI
categories.description: AI command-line tools in the launcher.

categories.title: System
categories.description: Default apps, screen, lock, power and touch.

entries.title: Light or dark
entries.description: Shell and apps follow this. Auto is dark while the night light runs.

entries.title: Colour source
entries.description: Standard keeps the neutral palette. Fixed uses the soft colours of the chosen style. Wallpaper reads the colours from your picture.

entries.title: Colour style
entries.description: Watercolor is light, airy and a little cool. Oil is denser, warmer and earthier. Only used when the colour source is not Standard.

entries.title: Palette follows night light
entries.description: Surfaces get warmer together with the screen colour temperature.

entries.title: Background blur
entries.description: Blur strength behind the Control Center and launcher.

entries.title: Animation speed
entries.description: Overall speed of motion in the shell.

entries.title: Wallpaper
entries.description: Opens the wallpaper picker.

entries.title: Wallpaper folder
entries.description: Pictures to choose from. Empty means ~/Pictures/Wallpapers.

entries.title: Top of the screen shows
entries.description: Show the bar or the island. Only one of them is shown. Saving asks you to confirm, and goes back by itself if you do not.

entries.title: Context zone
entries.description: Shows the window title, music, timers and alerts in the middle of the bar.

entries.title: Bar colour
entries.description: Off-white, or tinted with the colours of the chosen style. Only used when the colour source is not Standard.

entries.title: Hide bar in tablet mode
entries.description: Gives reading more room. Swipe from the top edge to bring it back.

entries.title: Island design
entries.description: Capsule: workspaces, time and status in one wide bar. Pill: a small floating pill that opens to a home card. Ticker: one line that rolls through time, weather, music and battery. Shade: a thin line that opens on a click.

entries.title: Opened card
entries.description: Dashboard: time and sliders, switches as pills. Bento: tiles, the time as one filled tile. Paper: a large time and round keys. Classic: the earlier card with its sections. Tap Wi-Fi or Bluetooth in the card to connect.

entries.title: Island look
entries.description: How the island looks. Paper, Ink, Bone, Outline, Float, Tab, Slate, Wash, Signal or Mono. Only used when the island is shown.

entries.title: Workspaces and window title
entries.description: Workspace numbers and the title of the active window on the left of the island.

entries.title: Status icons and battery
entries.description: Wi-Fi, volume, Bluetooth and battery on the right of the island.

entries.title: Date and weather
entries.description: The date under the time and the temperature next to the status icons.

entries.title: Music in the island
entries.description: Cover and a small level display next to the time while something plays, and the player in the opened island.

entries.title: Island alerts
entries.description: The island widens for a moment for a new notification, a low battery, a finished timer and a new track.

entries.title: Alert time
entries.description: How long an alert stays in the island.

entries.title: Open on hover
entries.description: Resting the pointer on the island opens the home card with the quick settings; leaving closes it. Click and touch always open it.

entries.title: Keep windows below the island
entries.description: On: windows start below the island, as with the bar. Off: the island floats over windows.

entries.title: Show the dock
entries.description: A dock at the bottom edge with pinned apps and open windows. Works with the bar and with the island. Right-click or long-press an app to pin it.

entries.title: Look
entries.description: Glass is see-through and soft. Solid is a plain panel. Minimal has no panel, only the icons.

entries.title: Apps in the dock
entries.description: The apps that always stay in the dock. Open apps that are not here appear after them while they run.

entries.title: Hide when not in use
entries.description: The dock slides away and comes back when the pointer touches the bottom edge.

entries.title: Zoom under the pointer
entries.description: Icons near the pointer grow a little, like a magnifying glass.

entries.title: Tiles
entries.description: Choose which tiles appear and in which order.

entries.title: Opens in mode
entries.description: Mode used when the launcher is opened without a specific shortcut.

entries.title: Web suggestions
entries.description: While on, every line you type in web mode is sent to your search engine to fetch suggestions. Works for Google, DuckDuckGo and Bing.

entries.title: Search engine
entries.description: Used by the web mode.

entries.title: Search engines
entries.description: Add your own search engine with a URL template.

entries.title: Providers
entries.description: Add, enable or remove AI command-line tools. Each provider needs a name, a command and arguments. A test button checks the command.

entries.title: Panel side
entries.description: Where the launcher sits in AI mode so the screen stays readable.

entries.title: Live Claude usage
entries.description: Fetches fresh usage numbers for the AI usage tile every 5 minutes. Needs your Claude login: a helper reads the token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json and sends it to api.anthropic.com only. It is never stored, logged or changed, and not refreshed (use Claude Code once if it expires). Uses an unofficial endpoint that can stop working.

entries.title: Calendar source
entries.description: Private iCal address first, Google sign-in later.

entries.title: Keyboard shortcuts
entries.description: Overview of all shortcuts. Clashes are marked. Change them in the Hyprland files named below.

entries.title: Launcher mode keys
entries.description: Switch modes while the launcher is open.

entries.title: Terminal
entries.description: Empty means automatic detection.

entries.title: File explorer
entries.description: Empty means automatic detection.

entries.title: Turn screen off after
entries.description: 0 = never. Only the display is switched off, the laptop never sleeps.

entries.title: Lock after
entries.description: Locks the screen only. The laptop is never put to sleep or hibernate.

entries.title: When the lid is closed
entries.description: The laptop never goes to sleep. It only locks the screen or does nothing.

entries.title: Stay awake in fullscreen
entries.description: A fullscreen window (reading, video) keeps the screen from locking or switching off.

entries.title: On-screen keyboard
entries.description: Shows the system on-screen keyboard when you tap a text field. Needs a keyboard app to be installed, otherwise nothing happens.

entries.title: Keyboard on lockscreen
entries.description: Built-in on-screen keyboard for unlocking in tablet mode. Auto shows it in tablet mode or after a touch.

entries.title: Edge swipes
entries.description: Swipe from the top edge for the Control Center, from the left edge for the launcher.

entries.title: Auto-rotate in tablet mode
entries.description: Turns the screen with the device, for example to portrait for reading.

entries.title: Show notification text on lockscreen
entries.description: Off keeps message contents private while the screen is locked.
